mentions.name: LoomDSP
mentions.description: A free/open source modular audio composition environment inspired by Eurorack modular, VCV Rack, and Bitwig Studio's The Grid.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a free/open source modular audio composition environment, called LoomDSP. It's inspired by Eurorack modular, VCV Rack, and Bitwig Studio's The Grid. Please feel free to suggest ideas and report bugs!
